Per your second rule, please also confirm whether a body-only figure like $2,902 may be used at all without a calculation source. I did not find one in what this turn actually searched, and I can't rule out places that were not searched. Unverified. - Decision needed: authorize a targeted mailbox search for "U-22" / "bead roller" plus the vendor quote threads and attachments, or accept $1,777.00 as a manual figure. **Row 3 — Manual Flanger — draft $1,609.00, 3–4 wks**
- No source found: same derivation check — nothing cataloged carries the manual flanger, and no mailbox excerpt shows a price. Unverified. - Decision needed: same as row 2 — targeted search, or confirm the $1,609.00 manual basis. **Row 4 — Roper Whitney No. I did not find one in what this turn actually searched, and I can't rule out places that were not searched. 622, and row 268 itself was not read in this turn. Unverified. - Decision needed: authorize reading workbook **row 268** (and the 622 vendor thread) to confirm $2,421.00, or leave as manual. **Row 5 — Tennsmith Single Wheel Slitter SLE24-16 — draft $8,880.00, 11–12 wks**
- Source: email Chandrakant Sharma → amacisaac@AlumaSafway.com, **2026-09-18** — SLE24-16 **$8,880.00 / 11–12 weeks**; same figure in his 2026-09-08 email to brendenrosser88@gmail.com. - Older source: 2026-08-19 email to m.kostiuk@tuffexteriors.com shows **$8,984.00**. - Discrepancy: draft matches the most recent figure; it is $104 below the Aug 19 quote (superseded).
